Scenario fixture: no-autoplay-audio

Each target media element has a stable id of the form naa_case_NN.

A. CANTTELL — autoplaying, unmuted, no controls mechanism

01 — CANTTELL: autoplaying <audio>, no controls, not muted
02 — CANTTELL: autoplaying <video>, no controls, not muted

B. Not flagged

03 — NEUTRAL: autoplaying but muted (not audible)
04 — NEUTRAL: autoplaying with native controls (pause/volume mechanism present)
05 — NEUTRAL: no autoplay attribute at all

End of fixture.
